`isnad2-eserler.rdf` is the example library published by the İSNAD Atıf Sistemi team
with the İSNAD 2nd edition Zotero template (https://www.isnadsistemi.org/indirmeler/,
"İSNAD Zotero ve Mendeley Şablonu 2. Edisyon"), licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. It is kept
unchanged and used only to test Derkenar's output against the İSNAD 2 guide.
